title: Milei Meets Rubio at UNGA Amid Falklands/Malvinas Diplomatic Row with UK
detail: President Javier Milei held a bilateral meeting with U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York, as Argentina was engaged in a public diplomatic row with UK Prime Minister over Falklands/Malvinas sovereignty. The meeting underscored Argentina's effort to shore up U.S. support for its longstanding territorial claim.
